en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a sculpted stone medallion set into a block wall. The medallion is diamond-shaped and contains a high-relief carving of a bearded religious figure, likely a bishop or saint, identifiable by his mitre (bishop's hat), ornate robe, and crozier (bishop's staff). The figure holds a book in his left hand, further emphasizing his ecclesiastical status. Decorative elements frame the medallion.
